correctness.rationale: Under char(K) ≠ 2, the twist phi=diag(-1,1,1) splits one negative eigenspace and a two-dimensional positive eigenspace, forcing K=[[a,0,0],[0,u,p],[0,v,t]]. For sole bracket [e1,e1]=e3, substitution into [Kx,Ky]=K([Kx,y]+[x,Ky]−[Kx,Ky]) gives exactly a(2−a)p=0 and a²=a(2−a)t. Solutions are disjoint A:a=0 free (u,p,v,t) and B:a≠0,2 with p=0,t=a/(2−a),u,v free. In Wang–Ke Example 3.3 the printed bracket-only solution K(e1)=e2, other images 0 violates twist compatibility by −2e2; it is not a Reynolds operator. Over odd F_q the total is q^4+q^3−2q² and ranks (1,(q−1)(q+1)^2,q(q³−q²−1),q(q−1)(q−2)); zeta (1−q²T)^2/((1−q⁴T)(1−q³T)). Fresh independent exhaustive enumeration q=3,5,7,11 matches totals and ranks; symbolic matrix argument covers arbitrary characteristic≠2.
